title: Connecting Points
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2\leq N\leq 1500; 1\leq Q\leq 1500; 0\leq x_i,y_i\leq 10^9; For queries of type 1, 0\leq a,b\leq 10^9.; For queries of type 3, let n be the number of vertices in G just before processing that query, then 1\leq u\lt v\leq n.; All input values are integers.
